title.narrative: Strengthening the decentralization and integration of malaria, HIV, and TB activities including the implementation of key malaria interventions to achieve malaria elimination

description.narrative: Sao Tome and Principe - Multicomponent - Ministry of Health of Sao Tome and Principe - MOH. This program has the following goals: Contribute to the elimination of tuberculosis by increasing tuberculosis detection to 95% in 2026. Contribute to the elimination of HIV/AIDS by ensuring a 100% detection rate of new HIV cases by 2026. Reduce the incidence of malaria from 18,2 in 2022 to 5,7 cases per 1000 inhabitants by 2026. The objectives of this program are: Maintain 100% detection rate of new HIV cases by 2026. Provide treatment to 95% of HIV patients and increase the viral suppression rate from 68% in 2022 to 90% by 2026. Keep the rate of mother-to-child transmission of HIV to less than 5 % by 2026. Increase new TB case detection rate from 61,6% in 2022 to 95% by 2026. Increase TB treatment coverage from 60 % in 2022 to 90 % by 2026. Increase the success rate of tuberculosis treatment from 80 % in 2022 to 95 % by 2026. Increase the investigation and classification of malaria cases from 90% in 2022 to 100% by 2026. Maintain a 100% malaria case detection rate at all levels, with quality diagnosis and appropriate treatment in line with the national case management policy by 2026. Increase MILDA possession coverage from 98 % in 2022 to 100 % in 2026 and PID coverage from 67 % in 2022 to 89 % in 2026.
